topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of how the innate immune system distinguishes self from non-self using molecular patterns and germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families and inflammasome signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the structure, cellular localization, and downstream signaling pathways of major pattern recognition receptors and the inflammasome.

topics.label: Cellular dynamics and pathology of the inflammatory response
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cell activation coordinates leukocyte trafficking, lymphatic antigen transport, and the systemic dangers of uncontrolled inflammatory signaling.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory responses are shut down, how tissues heal, and how unresolved damage leads to chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and states the topic of the next session.
